# Round-7 research prototypes (non-normative)

Throwaway scripts from research row R2 (converter feasibility),
copied out of the session scratchpad so later workers can read them (REVIEW RV-34). They are
**evidence, not implementation**: R7DEM.1/2 re-implement them as tested TypeScript in
`packages/demo-corpus` (REQ-CORPUS-11, REQ-CONV-1). Their outputs are deliberately NOT committed:
those outputs are derived from the corpus, which waits on the HUMAN-H14a sign-off (REQ-CORPUS-14).
Paths inside them point at the operator's local `~/agent-discourse` checkout.

R1's census/denylist scripts were Python and are deliberately **not** committed (AGENTS.md: TypeScript
end-to-end, no Python); R1's note records their method and results, and R7DEM.1 re-implements the denylist
gate in TypeScript.
